summary: The WelcomeSummary file is a complex ASP.NET Web Forms page focused on the summary, display, and bulk management of Placement Requests (PRs) in a system, tailored for different user roles (Placement Coordinator, Receiving Coordinator, others). It provides a dashboard-like interface with tables, filters, and actions for PRs, including Accept/Decline actions, supervisor assignments, mass actions, print generation, and various warning and error messaging capabilities.
purpose: To enable authorized users to review, filter, and act upon Placement Requests efficiently. The page handles mass selection and updates, conditional UI and validation logic based on the user role/stat, supervisor management, shift schedule and duration entry, and report generation as PDF or CSV. It coordinates interaction with backend workflow and reporting logic, serving as a primary actionable summary for PR operational tasks.

workflows.name: Bulk Placement Request Status Update
steps: User selects one or more Placement Requests using checkboxes.
User selects an action from 'ddNewStatus' (e.g., Accept/Decline/Dismiss/Reactivate/etc).
Depending on the action, additional fields may be required (e.g., reason for decline, notes, dates, supervisor selection).
Validations are performed (e.g., required reason, valid dates, numeric duration fields).
The operation is dispatched to backend logic (PlacementRequestDestinations.UpdateStatus/Print/etc).
Warnings/errors are shown if issues occur (e.g., missing reason, invalid transition, supervisor overlap).
Relevant emails or print jobs are triggered if indicated by the action.

workflows.name: Supervisor Assignment
steps: User opens the supervisor selector for a Placement Request.
Available supervisors are populated via AJAX/JS arrays.
User changes assignment; system checks for schedule overlaps.
If multiple preceptors, extra controls/screens are shown.

workflows.name: Dismiss/Restore Placement Requests
steps: User can dismiss PRs for N days (UserIgnoredPR/UserIgnoredPRsAdd).
Dismissed PRs are separated in the UI but can be restored.
Restoration resets PR visibility for the user.

workflows.name: PR Print/Report Generation
steps: User selects PRs and print options (PDF/CSV, report style).
Print job is created, relevant files generated, and download links generated.
Individual PDFs can be requested for each PR.

business_rules: Certain statuses/actions only available for certain roles or stats.
Supervisors can't be assigned to conflicting PRs.
Bulk actions (Accept/Decline/etc) only apply if at least one PR is selected.
Duration and Shift fields must be numeric and positive.
Certain actions (Reactivate, Cancel) prompt for confirmation.
Dismiss option is not available to DC users.
validations: Date fields must be valid and obey chronological order: StartDate <= ReplyByDate <= EndDate.
Duration fields (shifts, shift length, duration hours) must be numbers and > 0.
Reason and notes required for Decline (and 'Other').
RequiredFieldValidators, RegularExpressionValidators, CustomValidators, CompareValidators are widely used.
Resubmit must be confirmed if checked.
Prevent action if mandatory fields are not filled.
calculations: JavaScript functions recalculate and populate fields on change.
conditions: UI and actions vary by user role (e.g., only DC can use Accept/Decline buttons).
Dismissed PRs are only visible/active if not in DC Lite mode.
If no overdue PRs, overdue legend/key is hidden.
Certain list changes (status, supervisor) result in different validations and UI changes.
system_behavior: Asynchronous updates and JS-driven UI for enhanced UX.
AJAX popups for help/glossary and supervisor assignment.
On every change, the list and context is refreshed and re-bound.
Tracks context and user-specific view/configuration via UserSession and ViewState.
dependencies: Backend logic for placement request workflow (PlacementRequestDestinations, PlacementRequestStatusResults, etc.)
Staff controller for supervisor lists and assignments.
Codes/Dropdown resources for statuses, reasons, print/report types.
Resources for dynamic multi-lingual UI labels/tooltips.
JavaScript libraries for popups, date pickers, and enhanced controls.
SQL stored procedures for reporting and summary data.
exceptions: Permission errors (e.g., EndDate not updated if user lacks rights).
Invalid data errors (dates, durations, reason missing when required).
Invalid transition errors (e.g., prohibited status change).
content_gaps: Some referenced resources (e.g., localization tables, backend stored procedures, resource string values, and some underlying workflow) are not directly included. Exact field display names, tooltips, and some details of business context depend on these external resources.
Some logic is defined in referenced backend classes and procedures (e.g., PlacementRequestStatusResults, PlacementRequestDestinations), and not all concrete workflow branches are visible.
Exact UI rendering, error message text, and some detailed JS calculation may depend on runtime/user context.
